Giselle reminds everyone to wear comfortable shoes before practice. She emphasizes the importance of proper footwear, particularly because comfort is crucial for effective movement during the passing drills. This ensures that participants can maximize their performance and minimize the risk of injury during their training sessions. Her reminder serves as a practical tip to enhance overall training experience and results.
